name: Gujarat Intrux Limited
about: Gujarat Intrux Limited manufactures and supplies stainless, non-alloy, and alloy steel castings in India. It also manufactures sand and investment castings. The company exports its products in Germany, Israel, the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Finland. It serves pumps and valves; earth moving; gas, oil, and instrumentation; and general engineering casting industries. Gujarat Intrux Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Rajkot, India.
